header.running_head: The Incident of Hadhrat Sa'eed bin Aamir bin Hudhaym Jumhi (RA)

blocks.text: happily agreed, Hadhrat Sa'eed (RA) called someone from his family whom he trusted and placed the Dinaars into several bags. He then instructed the man to take one bag to a certain widow, another to a certain orphan, another to a certain poor person and another to a certain distressed person. This was done until there remained only a few Dinaars. He then (gave this to his wife and) said, "Spend this." Thereafter, he continued the activities of the governorship. She said, "Will you not get us a servant then? What has happened to the wealth?" Hadhrat Sa'eed (RA) replied, "It will come to you at a time when you need it most (in the Aakhirah)." [^1]
The Incident of Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA)

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Tha'laba bin Abu Maalik Qurazi
blocks.text: Hadhrat Tha'laba bin Abu Maalik Qurazi says, "It was during the period that Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) was the governor (of Madinah) for Marwaan that he came to the marketplace carrying a bundle of wood. He joked, 'Widen the road for the Ameer, O Ibn Abu Maalik!' 'But the road is wide enough for you,' I quipped. He the said, 'Widen the road for the Ameer with the bundle on his head.'"[^2]
Abu Nu'aym in his Hilya (Vol.1 Pg.245).
Abu Nu'aym in his Hilya (Vol.1 Pg.385).
